title: Snapbubble
generation_prompt: Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo FUTURE BASS instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 140 BPM in 4/4. The full audible rhythm starts immediately at time zero and stays present every second through 128 seconds: short firm kick on beats one and three, dry clap on beat three, clearly ticked eighth-note hats, and a separate bright midrange pluck attack on EVERY quarter beat. No fade-in, quiet intro, pad-only bar, breakdown, drop-out, half-time switch, tempo drift, long reverb wash or silent ending. The signature hook is a round bubbly synth pluck that jumps up a perfect fifth, followed one eighth beat later by a very short glassy snap note; repeat with changed pitch and stereo position, leaving each attack discrete and easy to tap. Under it use a bouncy sub bass and bright but soft major-seventh chord stabs; a restrained wide saw layer may swell behind the percussion but never mask the attacks. At 64 seconds keep the same full-volume drum grid, invert the bubbly two-note hook and let a higher three-note answer enter, change bass roots, then resolve at the end while drums remain audible. Cheerful, clean, spacious, child-friendly, controlled highs, no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, existing melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Generate a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Snapbubble, a playful all-ages future-bass rhythm-game track. Original high-contrast editorial comic-print collage on near-black ink, warm-ivory cut paper, coral red and electric cyan. ONE oversized irregular CYAN SOAP-BUBBLE shape is caught at the instant it snaps open into two asymmetric curved shell pieces; exactly THREE small coral square beat sparks fly diagonally from the split. Put a single warm-ivory short zigzag under the bubble to imply a bounced musical note. Make the bubble an opaque graphic cut-paper silhouette with a crisp edge, not a photo or glossy 3D render. Sparse halftone, strong asymmetry and readable shapes at 100px, with a quiet dark lower fifth for a local title overlay. No ring stack, planet, balloon string, person, city, landscape, screen, letters, words, logo, watermark or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Snapbubble square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve the ONE oversized asymmetric cyan bubble split into two curved paper shells, exactly THREE small separate coral square sparks, and one short warm-ivory zigzag beneath. Recompose those original shapes on the RIGHT two-thirds against near-black editorial comic-print ink, sparse halftone and warm-ivory accents; leave calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines on the left: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Snapbubble' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Design a real wide composition rather than stretching the square. No other text, letters, numbers, planet, balloon string, people, city, landscape, photograph, logo, watermark or copied game art.
